info.title: mutannot
info.description: Write mutations directly into your test code to verify your tests actually catch bugs.

commands.name: annotate-type
commands.description:
annotate an F# type with a ShouldCatch attribute from
a git diff.

options.name: --filter
options.description:
filter down to mutations that contain the given
search string.

options.name: --validate-only
options.description:
check if the patches apply, but don't run the
mutations.

commands.name: validate
commands.description:
quickly check that a source file's ShouldCatch
patches still apply, without building.
